extracted.intended_audience: school administrators, grant writers, and program managers seeking funding for educational/technical/vocational equipment
extracted.subtask_description: A practical guide for planning, preparing, submitting, and following up on grant proposals specifically to obtain funds for educational equipment in schools and postsecondary/technical programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assess program needs and write a justification for the support sought
rubrics_metrics.description: Assess program needs and write a justification for the support sought.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guide recommends identifying and documenting program equipment needs and producing a clear justification explaining why the requested equipment is necessary. Section 2 provides recommendations and instructions for identifying program equipment needs; Appendix B contains worksheets to help (e.g., needs assessment inputs that feed into the proposal justification).

rubrics_metrics.name: Review and select the funding sources that are the most appropriate
rubrics_metrics.description: Review and select the funding sources that are the most appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research federal, state, and private funding organizations to find those whose priorities match the program's activities and equipment needs. Section 1 lists various federal and state organizations and agencies; Appendix A lists 54 foundations and funding organizations and describes what activities and items they typically fund and how to contact them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop and submit a well-planned and carefully prepared proposal to request and justify support
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop and submit a well-planned and carefully prepared proposal to request and justify support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Section 3 presents guidelines, information, and directions to follow when preparing grant proposals and applications. Use the recommended planning worksheets (proposal outline, budget summary, timeline, etc.) to ensure the proposal is organized, justified, and conforms to funder expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow up the proposal with appropriate communications to the sponsoring organization
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow up the proposal with appropriate communications to the sponsoring organization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After submission, maintain appropriate follow-up communications with the sponsor to check status, provide requested clarifications, and foster relationships. The guide lists follow-up as a distinct recommended step but does not provide full detailed scripts on the summary page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use a proposal development and sign-off schedule
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appendix B includes a worksheet to schedule proposal development tasks and formal sign-offs, indicating recommended use of a timeline/approval process to coordinate contributors and obtain necessary authorizations before submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include an outline of a typical proposal
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appendix B provides an 'outline of a typical proposal' to be used as a template for organizing content. The outline is intended to structure the proposal so that justification, activities, budget, timeline, and evaluation are presented in a funder-friendly order.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare an activity-task planning schedule and project timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: Activity-task planning schedule and project timeline (worksheets).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these worksheets (listed in Appendix B) to break the project into tasks, assign timings and milestones, and present a realistic schedule in the proposal. These documents support feasibility and implementation claims in the proposal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare a personnel utilization matrix
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document staff roles, responsibilities, and time commitments using the personnel utilization matrix in Appendix B to demonstrate that personnel resources are allocated and justified for project activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide a clear, itemized budget summary (sample format)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sample format for a budget summary (worksheet).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appendix B includes a sample budget summary format to itemize equipment costs and related expenses. Guidance implies budgets should be clear, itemized, and aligned with the needs justification and project timeline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use a proposal checklist and evaluation form
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appendix B contains a proposal checklist and evaluation form intended for self-review prior to submission. Use it to verify completeness, alignment with funder priorities, adequacy of justification, accuracy of budget/timeline, and readiness for sign-off.
